subject: Medford High School OPM Request for Services
overview: The committee approved the Request for Services (RFS) to hire an Owner's Project Manager for the Medford Comprehensive High School project. The body also received updates on MSBA enrollment certification and expanded the OPM selection subcommittee membership.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved minutes from September 18, 2024, and tabled two sets of minutes missing from the meeting packet.

items.title: MSBA Phase One Eligibility Update
items.summary: Chair Jenny Graham reported that the district successfully completed the MSBA eligibility phase and reached an enrollment agreement for a total capacity of 1,395 students.

items.title: MSBA Phase Two Planning Overview
items.summary: The committee reviewed the timeline for Phase Two, which involves onboarding an Owner's Project Manager and a designer before beginning the feasibility study.

items.title: OPM Request for Services Approval
items.summary: Approved the Request for Services (RFS) for an Owner's Project Manager, which establishes a projected project cost range of $200 million to $600 million. Discussion focused on sustainability certifications, site-specific egress challenges, and the MSBA-mandated evaluation criteria for potential bidders.

items.title: OPM Selection Subcommittee Expansion
items.summary: Voted to add Libby Brown and Dr. Suzanne Galussi as voting members and Paul Ruseau as a non-voting member to the OPM Selection Subcommittee to ensure a broader vetting of candidates.
